_comment: PRACTICE rules pack (not from the official manual). Every rule the CODE checks lives here; the prompt .md keeps only prose (tone, how to talk). On 2026-11-21 make an official pack (see README.md). Sections: functions/_default = pre-execution gate (team/agent/gate.py) and the auto-generated [함수 실행 규칙] prompt section; confirm_template (optional, per write function) = the question said directly when the gate blocks for missing consent, filled with the call's arguments; handoff = hand-off signal keywords (policy.handoff_flags, memo only); consent = consent / refusal word patterns used by the gate; output_check = word patterns of the output check's unconfirmed-time rule. Regex values are Python re syntax.
_official_note: get_return_info, search_products, return_order, return_order_item, exchange_order and buyer_cellphone were added on 11/21 only so the 8 official functions are not blocked by _default; same pattern as the existing entries. Review confirm modes against the official scenarios (LLM owner).

output_check._comment: Output check 'time' (team/agent/output_guard.py): a non-question, non-negated sentence with a time word AND a contact/booking word is replaced unless some function result carries a time value (result_time).
